title: •_Bright Hope_
caption: •_Bright Hope_ (V)
game_text: May add 2 pilots and 6 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During battle, if with a Rebel capital starship, may use 1 Force to cancel a just drawn battle destiny.
lore: Modified medium transport. Well armored. Has expanded passenger capacity to facilitate evacuation. The last transport to escape Hoth. Nearly destroyed by the _Stalker_.

notes: Unique. 'Bright Hope' italic in the slip's heading and caption (marked _…_ as vs5/39, vs5/46). Banner CAPITAL: TRANSPORT. Stats POWER 2 / ARMOR 4 / HYPERSPEED 5; deploy 3 / forfeit 5. Scomp-link ring at the top-left of the text box → scomp true. Icon column top to bottom: yellow Pilot helmet (the permanent-pilot icon, as vs4/29 Blizzard 2 — 'Permanent pilot provides ability of 2'), red square with green dome → nav. Slip text matches the stub. Lore corrected from scan: 'Stalker' is italic (_Stalker_); wiki has plain text. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Cloud City) not legible here. Modern: V3-L-brighthope.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 3 remake); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
